rows.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
rows.answer:

rows.message: When will the money from yesterday's sales be deposited?
rows.answer:
The money is deposited into your Get Conta on the morning of the receiving date you chose when you signed up [sup-get-conta-acesso-03].

- **Two-day option:** If you chose to receive 2 days after the sale, the money arrives in the morning, within 2 business days [sup-duvidas-40].
- **Prepaid cards:** Debit sales are received within 1 business day and credit sales within 2 business days [sup-duvidas-114]. The Payment Link page gives the same terms [prod-link-de-pagamento-03].

You can check your sales statement in the Getnet Brasil app or on the Minha Conta portal [sup-get-conta-acesso-03].

I can't tell which plan or receiving date your account has, so I can't give an exact date for yesterday's sales. If you'd like, I can hand your case to a human agent.

rows.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
rows.answer:
Getnet lets you receive your credit sales early, whether they were paid upfront or in installments. You do it through the Getnet Brasil app for Android and iOS [sup-antecipar-app-01]. The app has no extra fee [sup-duvidas-15].

**In the app**
- Log in and go to Services, then Antecipação de Vendas [sup-antecipar-app-01][sup-antecipar-app-02].
- The screen shows the amount available to advance and your registered bank accounts. Choose the account that will receive the money [sup-antecipar-app-02].
- Accept the terms and run the simulation. It shows the amounts, card brands and fees [sup-antecipar-app-02].
- Confirm and check the final amount. Then click Antecipar and enter your password [sup-antecipar-app-02].
- Track the request under "Meus Pedidos". The minimum to advance is R$50,00 [sup-antecipar-app-02].

**Automatic advance**
- You can enable it in the Portal under "Produtos e Serviços". Enabling it is free. An advance only happens if you have a balance of at least R$ 50,00 [sup-antecipacao-automatica-portal-02].
- It is also a condition for the exemption on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan. Getnet reviews each contract individually to decide whether to grant it, because it involves credit approval [sup-duvidas-100].

The sources don't give the fee percentage for advancing. The app simulation shows the fees before you confirm [sup-antecipar-app-02]. If you want the exact rates, I can pass your case to a human agent.

rows.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
rows.answer:
You can split a sale into up to 48 installments with the Crediário. Your customer pays the installments on their credit card [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01].

- **Limit by card:** The maximum term and the interest rate depend on the card issuer, so the limit can be lower for some cards [prod-crediario-02].
- **When you get paid:** You receive the full sale amount in a single payment within 2 business days after the transaction is captured, whatever the number of installments. The discount fee is subtracted from the original amount [sup-duvidas-37].
- **Comparison:** Parcelado Emissor is a different product and allows up to 24 installments [sup-duvidas-75].

failures.answer:
Getnet lets you receive your credit sales early, whether they were paid upfront or in installments. You do it through the Getnet Brasil app for Android and iOS [sup-antecipar-app-01]. The app has no extra fee [sup-duvidas-15].

**In the app**
- Log in and go to Services, then Antecipação de Vendas [sup-antecipar-app-01][sup-antecipar-app-02].
- The screen shows the amount available to advance and your registered bank accounts. Choose the account that will receive the money [sup-antecipar-app-02].
- Accept the terms and run the simulation. It shows the amounts, card brands and fees [sup-antecipar-app-02].
- Confirm and check the final amount. Then click Antecipar and enter your password [sup-antecipar-app-02].
- Track the request under "Meus Pedidos". The minimum to advance is R$50,00 [sup-antecipar-app-02].

**Automatic advance**
- You can enable it in the Portal under "Produtos e Serviços". Enabling it is free. An advance only happens if you have a balance of at least R$ 50,00 [sup-antecipacao-automatica-portal-02].
- It is also a condition for the exemption on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan. Getnet reviews each contract individually to decide whether to grant it, because it involves credit approval [sup-duvidas-100].

The sources don't give the fee percentage for advancing. The app simulation shows the fees before you confirm [sup-antecipar-app-02]. If you want the exact rates, I can pass your case to a human agent.

failures.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
failures.answer:
You can split a sale into up to 48 installments with the Crediário. Your customer pays the installments on their credit card [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01].

- **Limit by card:** The maximum term and the interest rate depend on the card issuer, so the limit can be lower for some cards [prod-crediario-02].
- **When you get paid:** You receive the full sale amount in a single payment within 2 business days after the transaction is captured, whatever the number of installments. The discount fee is subtracted from the original amount [sup-duvidas-37].
- **Comparison:** Parcelado Emissor is a different product and allows up to 24 installments [sup-duvidas-75].
